method: OpenStreetMap way 28028422 (building, name 'WIHA') used verbatim; PSI's site-map legend gives 'WIHA Injektorhalle 2' (src:psi-geo-arealplan-2015), i.e. the hall of the Injector 2 cyclotron (the 72 MeV stage of HIPA). Footprint 52.1 m x 19.1 m, area 988 m2. No official dimension was found to check it against, so confidence stays approximate.
name: PSI Injector 2 hall (WIHA)
notes: Context building (no atlas record depicts the injector cyclotron); accelerator:psi-hipa stays in map.unlocated because the Ring Cyclotron itself is not located.

summary.plain: The hall of PSI's Injector 2 cyclotron, which brings the protons to 72 MeV before the Ring Cyclotron.
